category_title: Reactive bully-victims with SEBD who respond to peer harassment with physical aggression
scenario_title: Reporting peer conflicts and teacher intervention
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the school office with a staff member to fill out a concern card after a peer conflict.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a concern card. Write your name, the problem, and where it happened.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I get angry when people are annoying me. Like just say calling me names, hurting me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: If someone hurt me, like kicked me or something, they wouldn't do anything about it. I would overreact and start going off to them and trying to kick them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Since you've been in trouble so many times, just write down what you did wrong.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The teachers always blamed things on you, cos you’ve been in trouble so many times, they think it was you instantly. I know that the teachers think that I’m bad, so they’ll just go for their side, so I don’t bother to say anything. (Pushes the concern card away)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is a concern card. Write your name, the problem, and where it happened.

STUDENT: I get angry when people are annoying me. Like just say calling me names, hurting me.

TUTOR: What did you do?

STUDENT: If someone hurt me, like kicked me or something, they wouldn't do anything about it. I would overreact and start going off to them and trying to kick them.

TUTOR: Since you've been in trouble so many times, just write down what you did wrong.

STUDENT: The teachers always blamed things on you, cos you’ve been in trouble so many times, they think it was you instantly. I know that the teachers think that I’m bad, so they’ll just go for their side, so I don’t bother to say anything. (Pushes the concern card away)

task.content: Reporting a bullying incident and resolving peer conflict

context.social_setting: Interacting with a teacher or staff member after a conflict has occurred

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher takes the other kids' side, assumes the student is to blame based on past behavior, or claims to be too busy to listen
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Not bothering to say anything, stopping reporting of bullying
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling that teachers are indifferent, ineffective, and biased against them; feeling unfairly targeted
related_quotes: I know that the teachers think that I’m bad, so they’ll just go for their side, so I don’t bother to say anything.
The teachers always blamed things on you, cos you’ve been in trouble so many times, they think it was you instantly.

behavior_patterns.condition: When teachers force them to the ground instead of the kids that kicked them
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Overreacting and starting to go off to them and trying to kick them
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feeling angry and that the treatment is unfair
related_quotes: If someone hurt me, like kicked me or something, they (the teachers) wouldn’t do anything about it. I would overreact and start going off to them and trying to kick them. So they (the teachers) forced me to the ground, not the kids that kicked me.
